    • toConstraintOpportunityEvidenceMap

      public Map<String,Object> toConstraintOpportunityEvidenceMap()
      Builds a deterministic physical-headroom screen for follow-up constraint studies.

      Rejecting rows are labelled as current constraint investigations and feasible rows as next-bottleneck candidates. Every row retains one exact sampled or refined representative, the applicable limit and its provenance. The screen does not estimate production gain or authorize a limit change; a separately qualified paired relief study remains required before reporting debottleneck benefit.

      Returns:
      deeply immutable JSON-friendly opportunity screen
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a ranked row lacks finite physical representative evidence

    • toConstraintOpportunityEvidenceMap

      public Map<String,Object> toConstraintOpportunityEvidenceMap(List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.QualifiedReliefStudyEvidence> qualifiedReliefStudies)
      Builds the opportunity screen and attaches only exact qualified paired-relief receipts.
      Parameters:
      qualifiedReliefStudies - receipts produced by ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.qualifyReliefStudy(neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelOperatingPointOptimizer.OperatingPointSearchResult, neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy, neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.StudyResult)
      Returns:
      deeply immutable JSON-friendly opportunity screen
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if receipts are duplicated or do not match an installed opportunity row
      IllegalStateException - if a ranked row lacks finite physical representative evidence
